title: The Vanishing Viscosity Limit and Boundary Layers for Symmetric Fluid Flows with Anisotropic Viscosity
summary: We study the vanishing viscosity limit for the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with anisotropic viscosity in bounded domains, analyzing certain classes of symmetric flows: plane parallel, pipe parallel and circularly symmetric. By anisotropic viscosity, it is meant here that the viscosity coefficient in the direction normal to the wall is different than that in the direction tangential to the wall.
